h1: Workflow monitoring for success rates, delays and errors
overview: A workflow that fails quietly is worse than one that never ran. We add a monitoring view that counts runs, successes, failures and waiting time, then alerts you when a number crosses a line you set. You get a simple dashboard in a tool you already use and a plain note on what each figure means, so you can spot trouble before a customer does.

faq: Where will I see the numbers?
In Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Airtable or a chat channel, whichever your team already checks. We keep it simple so someone actually looks at it.
Can you monitor workflows you did not build?
Often yes, when the tool exposes run history or we can add a small counting step. We check this first and tell you what can and cannot be tracked.
Will you fix the errors it finds?
The monitor shows you what failed and why. Repairs are outside this package, but the fix checklist covers common causes, and we can quote repairs or ongoing care separately.
How do you decide what counts as slow?
We look at normal run times together, then set a limit that flags the unusual. You can raise or lower the limit later without our help.
